title: Feedback Request ( Ai Usage Warning )
author: NeutralBot
selftext:
I've been working on a card game and I need feedback. However, whenever I post somewhere requesting it I usually only get criticism on my usage of ai / ai art, without them actually playing and letting me know what they liked / disliked about the game itself. If you've got some free time and you enjoy card games, lmk me what you enjoy or hate my project, thanks!  

Note there is no tutorial in game yet, most ppl say it takes round 3 games to understand.

Safe Download Here: [https://convergence-development.com/](https://convergence-development.com/)

Play from Browser here: [https://play.convergence-development.com/](https://play.convergence-development.com/)

Or you can also play it within Discord (link on website)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/NeutralBot please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.
